scope: The historic Castle Rushen exterior in Castletown as seen in 2005, with its limestone keep, curtain wall, lower gatehouse and forecourt.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The operator describes the limestone fortress, drawbridge, keep and relationship to Castletown harbour.
The Manx National Heritage exhibit places the tallest of the four keep towers at 24 m.
The official significance assessment identifies the keep, outer ward, curtain, gatehouse, barbican, moat and glacis.
